transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I just don’t care about things I used to enjoy. Murals, going for runs, basketball, even making a good drink at work—none of it feels like mine anymore. I just stand there and feel nothing about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months now. It started after the bar got bought out and they changed everything I’d been working toward.
Along with losing interest in things, have you been feeling consistently down, sad, or depressed?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad exactly. It’s more like I just feel flat… disconnected from everything.
How has your sleep been over these past two months?
I lie down tired, but my head just keeps going over every mistake I made at work. Then when I finally do fall asleep, I wake up around four or five and can’t get back to sleep.
Have you ever gone through a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that felt quite like this.
How have your energy levels been lately?
Pretty low. By the time I carry a couple cases of liquor or set up the well, I feel like I’ve already worked a double, even if I haven’t done much that day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over these past two months?
Most days I forget to eat until my hands start shaking behind the bar. Then after closing I might take a few bites of something cold, but honestly, just looking at food makes me feel sick.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling like a failure lately?
Yeah. I keep thinking I let down the younger bartenders, and the artists I told I’d make room for. Like I wrecked their chance somehow. It feels like I deserve whatever happens to me because of it.
Have things gotten so difficult that you have had thoughts of giving up, or thoughts of death or hurting yourself?
I’m not sure what you mean by “giving up.” Things have been really hard, but I don’t know.
Have you had thoughts of wanting to die, or wishing you would go to sleep and not wake up?
I... I don’t know. I haven’t really thought about it that clearly.
